summary: Runtime dependency pulled from unpinned GitHub repository default branch
details: package.json declares a runtime dependency `libsignal` with the value `github:tenka-san/libsignal-node`, an off-registry git source with no commit SHA, no tag, and no integrity check. `npm install @bellaxchan/wbails@1.8.2` resolves this dependency to whatever bytes currently sit on the default branch of that GitHub repository and executes any lifecycle scripts the fetched tree contains. The content of the target repository can be changed at any time by whoever controls it, so install-time behavior for consumers of this package is not fixed by the published tarball. The target repository owner (`tenka-san`) does not match the publishing scope (`@bellaxchan`), so a third-party controls the executed code path.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
